title: PET 瓶再生製程
summary: 以「瓶級PET的材質純化、乾燥與去污驗證」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow bottle-grade pet purification, drying and decontamination validation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 整瓶與瓶片的雙段分選：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Whole-bottle and flake sorting: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 整瓶與瓶片的雙段分選 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Whole-bottle and flake sorting and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 整瓶先移除大部分異材，破碎後再按材質與顏色精選瓶片，兩段的漏選不一定獨立。
steps.instructionEn: Whole-bottle sorting removes bulk foreign material before flake material/colour sorting; misses may be correlated.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95)；計算 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg。適用限制：僅假設兩段獨立且同一污染群。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95); calculation 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg. Applicability: Assumes independent stages acting on the same contaminant population.
steps.failure: 直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both.
steps.check: 用同一組難辨識異材追蹤兩段漏選是否相關。
steps.checkEn: Track difficult contaminants through both stages to test correlated misses.

操作任務：在「整瓶與瓶片的雙段分選」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
steps.instructionEn:
Track difficult contaminants through both stages to test correlated misses.
Action: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for whole-bottle and flake sorting, first reproduce 0.5 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95)；計算 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg。適用限制：僅假設兩段獨立且同一污染群。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: independent residual=100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95); calculation 100*(1-0.9)*(1-0.95) = 0.5 kg. Applicability: Assumes independent stages acting on the same contaminant population.
steps.failure: 直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both.
steps.check: 用同一組難辨識異材追蹤兩段漏選是否相關。
steps.checkEn: Track difficult contaminants through both stages to test correlated misses.
